reviews.author: shahnawaz
reviews.title: Native M1 product and service both are fine
reviews.body: Very nice product, installation was so smooth and timely. Service person mr. Ankit was so friendly and worked well.

reviews.author: Waste of money product
reviews.title: Most reliable and tensionfree RO
reviews.body: I received this RO the next day after ordering. The installation by Urban Company was very smooth. The water tank TDS was 390, and after filtration I'm getting 55 TDS. The taste of the water is good. Overall, I'm satisfied with this product. It gives me a tension-free life for 2 years.

reviews.author: mahesh kumar
reviews.title: Excellent Product & Superb Service - Totally Worth It! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
reviews.body: Native M1 Pro bahut hi badhiya product hai. Delivery ekdum fast hui. Installation Urban Company team ne two days me kar di, technician ka behaviour bahut professional tha. Purifier ka design stylish hai aur paani ka taste ekdum natural aur meetha hai. RO + Copper + Alkaline ki wajah se paani light hai. App me live TDS dekh sakte hai. 2 saal ki warranty ka tension-free feature best hai. Highly satisfied! Thank you team! Loved the Native M1 Pro - Premium look, great water taste, super quick delivery and very professional installation. App monitoring feature is excellent. Very happy customer! 👍

reviews.author: Santosh Nangare
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.body: "The Native M1 is an amazing water purifier. It has a very sleek and modern design that looks great in the kitchen. The 10-stage filtration gives complete peace of mind about water safety. The taste of the water improved instantly after installation. Great value for money and totally hassle-free!" 👍

reviews.author: Dev
reviews.title: Excellent Purifier
reviews.body: The installation process was flawless. The technician who installed my purifier was incredibly knowledgeable. He took the time to explain how the system actually works behind the scenes and shared several important details that the company doesn’t explicitly mention in the standard specs sheet. Knowing these "hidden" engineering details makes me appreciate the product even more. The water taste is excellent, and the build quality feels premium.
